description: Reads The Tennis Desk's own docs, word for word. They cover what the Desk is, a Desk level, what is free and what the Desk Pass adds, coverage and updates, agents, privacy and how a league table is ordered. Call it when someone asks about the Desk itself rather than a team, a player or a match. Pass `about`, a few words on what to find, and `pages` for a page you know. It needs no Desk Pass, and a call does not count toward the account's daily or monthly limit.

about.description: A few words on what to find, for example 'how it compares with NTRP'. With no `pages`, the sections of any page that match it.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

pages.description: One or two docs pages, each named by its address after /docs/, as https://thetennisdesk.com/docs.md lists them, for example 'desk-level'. The front page is 'index'. A page read_docs does not hold is answered with the pages it holds. Optional: leave it out to find a topic on any page.

name: read_docs
title: Paragraphs from the Desk's docs
